aboutText: Hello and welcome to my portfolio! My name is Noah CHARRIN-BOURRAT and I am in my third year of a bachelor's degree in computer science at Toulouse Ynov Campus. During my first and second years, I discovered a strong interest in software and mobile application development, but my curiosity and passion for computer science drive me to explore many different fields. I enjoy creating very diverse projects, from video games and APIs to complete web applications. I am always eager to learn new technologies, tackle technical challenges, and turn ideas into concrete and functional products. If my profile interests you, feel free to contact me via the <1>contact<1/> form or the information provided in the contact section of this portfolio.
